messages:
Maya: Quick micro-check for the Q3 OKR milestones — want a short snapshot of what actually shipped vs slipped and any immediate owner asks. Keeping it async, drop one-line updates.
Diego: infra feature gating shipped yesterday (auto-scale patches). Can confirm baseline perf metrics are green. :tada:
Sara: embedding-search v2 rollout slipped — perf regressions on long queries. Root cause looks like a caching bug. Owner: sara. ETA fix in 48h.
Jon: client SDK 0.8.1 shipped (docs + py/ts fixes). Sending CR pings for the follow-up cleanup PR #3421 — @Maya & @Tess please take a look when you can.
Tess: taking CR on #3421 today, should be done by EOD. Also noticed a minor telemetry gap; filing a follow-up ticket.
Maya: thanks — for slipped embedding-search, is there a mitigation we can ship sooner (config toggle or revert)?
Sara: yes — temporary toggle to fall back to v1 is ready. I'll open the rollback PR and attach a short rollout plan.
Diego: note: dedicated pools will require a config tweak in the autoscaler to avoid cold starts during rollout — assigning to diego.
Jon: Tagging rollout steps in case:
```
# canary rollout
kubectl apply -f canary-deploy.yaml
monitor perf x 30m
if stable -> promote
else -> rollback
```
Tess: FYI release-bot flagged a canary anomaly earlier today (latency spike). ReleaseBot: log attached.
ReleaseBot: [automated] Canary anomaly detected for route /v1/generate at 09:12 UTC — 95p latency 2.3s (>1.5s threshold). Correlation: increased batch sizes.
Maya: good callout. Diego, can you reduce max batch size on canary?
Diego: reducing max batch to 8 now, will monitor for 1h.
Sara: opened rollback PR #3430 and added test plan + toggle instructions. CC: @Maya, @Jon for review.
Jon: I reviewed #3430 — small nit in the test script, will push in a minute.
Tess: CR done on #3421, merged. Maya: any objections to promoting client SDK shards tomorrow?
Maya: go ahead, just ensure release notes call out the embedding rollback as a potential compatibility note.
Diego: after batch tweak, canary latency back to 1.2s. Looks stable for now.
Maya: summary for OKR tracker: shipped - infra autoscale patch, client SDK 0.8.1; slipped - embedding-search v2 (owner: Sara, rollback toggle in PR #3430, ETA 48h); action items - Diego reduce batch, Tess CRs merged, Jon to greenlight promote after smoke.
Sara: adding note to OKR doc with links to PRs and short postmortem once fixed.
Maya: perfect. If anyone needs a follow-up sync, say so here; otherwise we'll treat this as the async record. :white_check_mark:
Tess: all good from my side.
Jon: same.
Diego: 👍
Sara: thanks all — will ping when rollback is validated.
